# discord_invite (Resource)

Manages a channel invite. Invites cannot be edited, so every change creates a new invite. An invite that expires or is revoked outside Terraform is created again on the next apply. Reading invites requires the Manage Channels permission on the channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_invite" "website" {
  channel_id = discord_text_channel.general.id
  max_age    = 0 # never expires
}

output "invite_url" {
  value = discord_invite.website.url
}

# Grants a role on joining and can only be accepted by the listed users.
resource "discord_invite" "beta_testers" {
  channel_id      = discord_text_channel.general.id
  max_age         = 604800
  role_ids        = [discord_role.beta.id]
  target_user_ids = ["456789012345678901", "567890123456789012"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel to invite to.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `max_age` (Number) Seconds until the invite expires, between `0` (never) and `604800` (7 days). Defaults to `86400`.
- `max_uses` (Number) Maximum number of uses between `0` (unlimited) and `100`. Defaults to `0`.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) IDs of roles given to the users who accept the invite. Requires the Manage Roles permission, and the roles must be below the bot's highest role.
- `target_application_id` (String) ID of the application an `embedded_application` invite opens. The application must have the `EMBEDDED` flag.
- `target_type` (String) What a voice channel invite opens: `stream` shows `target_user_id`'s stream and `embedded_application` opens the `target_application_id` activity.
- `target_user_id` (String) ID of the user whose stream a `stream` invite shows. The user must be streaming in the channel.
- `target_user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the only users who can see and accept the invite, at most 1000. Users are added and removed in place; setting or removing the argument creates a new invite. Changes made outside Terraform are detected only while the argument is set, and it is not imported. Changing the users requires the bot to have created the invite or to have the Manage Server permission.
- `temporary` (Boolean) Whether the invite grants temporary membership. Defaults to `false`.
- `unique` (Boolean) Whether to always create a new invite. When `false`, Discord may return an existing invite with the same settings, which other resources could then share. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Invite code.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite expires (RFC 3339), or null if it never expires.
- `id` (String) Invite code.
- `url` (String) Invite URL, `https://discord.gg/<code>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_invite.website
  identity = {
    channel_id = "123456789012345678"
    code       = "abc123XY"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel.
- `code` (String) Invite code.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_invite.website <channel_id>/<code>
```
